guidance.title: What the verdicts mean
guidance.text: Exact-target catalog audit for Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.267, Java 21, checked 21 November 2026. Horizon source is now 0.2.0 with 116 locked mods. Native build means a file is listed for this exact game/loader pair. It does not mean the combined pack has been launched or proven compatible. No mods were installed, no code was ported, and no existing game files were changed. Dependencies still need exact-version resolution before installation.

guidance.title: Current scope
guidance.text: Spatial GUI and Companions! (companions-mod) were confirmed by the user. Fresh n’ Musical was explicitly excluded. Fantasy Armor and Fantasy Weapons are split into separate rows; Sounds + More Sounds are also split. There are 73 tracked rows, 72 active. FallingTree, ATMOSPHERICS, Animated Hearts and Primal retain identity notes where similarly named projects exist.

guidance.title: Player animation and camera ownership
guidance.text: Punchy!, Punchy! Moves, FA Player Extension, Better Combat, Eating Animation, Cinematic Interactions, Auto Third Person, Spatial GUI, Grand Teleport, Respawn Recap and Seamless Sleep affect overlapping actions or camera states. Native availability is not proof they all work together. Give combat/spellcasting their own tested animation path; configure per-screen and per-action exclusions. Test actual melee, aiming, eating, spellcasting, riding, inventory, teleport, sleep and respawn. Do not layer multiple player rigs blindly.

guidance.title: Particle and sound overlap
guidance.text: Subtle Effects is already locked at 1.15.3; Particle Rain is already present. Visuality, Effectual, Perception, Cave Dust, Better Smoke, Windy, Footprint Particle and Particle Interactions overlap parts of this coverage. Sounds, More Sounds, AmbientSounds, Cool Rain and separate equip/landing sounds can duplicate events. Tune per-effect ownership and profile budgets. FWA and Swinging Lanterns both animate lanterns. These are integration risks, not observed crash reports.

guidance.title: Terrain and structure integration
guidance.text: Blooming Biosphere has a 1.21.1 datapack; it is not simply a foliage cosmetic. Its author describes an Overworld biome overhaul and provides a Tectonic compatibility project. That does not establish compatibility with the combined Terralith/Tectonic stack. Infinity Cave has a native mod wrapper and explicitly tells Terralith users to use the mod version; its author also warns about beta compatibility. Streams Reflowing advertises terrain compatibility, but the actual pack still needs seed/worldgen/performance tests. Moog’s Mineshafts overlaps YUNG’s/Repurposed mineshafts. Grim Kingdoms, Homesteads and new bosses need spacing and loot-budget integration. No worldgen addition should silently replace old chunks.

guidance.title: Porting and permission
guidance.text: No target build found means a port/backport is needed for the exact identified project unless an unlisted compatible build is supplied. It is not proof a project can legally or practically be ported. Feur is All Rights Reserved with no verified source link; Cube Animals is also ARR with no verified source route here. Soft Leaves exposes a source link but lists ARR. Confirm permission before distributing modifications. Public source does not automatically grant permission. Resource-pack adaptation is a different task from a mod-loader port.

guidance.title: Prism packaging
guidance.text: The current project builds a Modrinth .mrpack. CurseForge-only availability and runtime compatibility are separate questions: Weather Glass, Cinematic Interactions and Cube Animals were checked on their author-published CurseForge file lists. Preserve permitted downloads or use an appropriate manifest/manual download path. Do not assume any available jar may be embedded in the pack.

guidance.title: Fresh Animations: coherent base
guidance.text: Use Fresh Animations 1.11.2 for 1.20+ (the file explicitly includes 1.21.1), with NeoForge EMF and ETF. Candidate catalog files: EMF 3.3.12-neoforge-1.21 and ETF 7.2.7-neoforge-1.21; resolve their mutual minimum versions and test with the pinned renderer. Do not install OptiFine into the Sodium/Iris stack.

guidance.title: Fresh Animations: official extensions
guidance.text: Fresh Animations: Extensions 1.10.1 combines Creepers, Details, Emissive, Quivers, Spiders, Objects and Classic Horses. Place the extension pack above the base in resource-pack priority. The separate component projects are catalogued below for selective use; do not install all individual components on top of the combined bundle. Spider Overhaul may replace the renderer or models that FA Spiders expects; test or select one approach.

guidance.title: Fresh Animations: player and modded coverage
guidance.text: FA Player Extension 1.1.0 (see exact version in the addon list if upstream metadata changes) is optional and must be tested against Better Combat, Punchy Moves and spellcasting. Player Compats is a conditional patch, not universal support for all modded items. F.M.R.P 3.0.5 provides modded-entity coverage and optionally uses Semos Animations Lib; check actual supported mobs. Fresh Compats targets Supplementaries, Quark, Sleep Tight and You’ve Goat to be Kidding Me, which are not in the current lock. Fresh Illager Mod Compats likewise only earns inclusion for actual supported mods. These packs do not magically animate every Cataclysm, GeckoLib or Companions entity.

guidance.title: Fresh Animations: scope of addon search
guidance.text: Audited the author’s public Modrinth project catalog plus relevant public mod-compat packs. Official patches for Rotten Creatures, Boy Why You So Ears, BARCHED, Spawn, More Mob Variants, Variants and Ventures, Barely Default and other art families are conditional on those projects being installed. Some official model ports are membership early access; they were not downloaded or treated as freely available. Arbitrary third-party texture overhauls are alternatives requiring matching FA patches, not an instruction to stack every addon on the internet.

guidance.title: Animation pack priority
guidance.text: Working proposal, highest priority first: small proven per-mod/player compatibility patches; chosen official FA extension bundle or selected individual components; FA Player Extension only if selected; Fresh Animations base; ordinary base textures. Follow each patch author’s order when more specific. Resolve overlapping entity/model paths deliberately. Keep Punchy Moves’ required Fluid & Foolish animation pack separate from the FA mob stack and test interactions.

guidance.title: What remains before calling the pack compatible
guidance.text: Resolve dependencies and minimum NeoForge versions; inspect mod descriptors for misleading catalog tags; staged launch test; shader and Voxy checks; representative combat/camera/UI actions; structure/loot checks in new chunks; multiplayer server-side separation; matched frame-time and worldgen measurements. No individual catalog entry is an acceptance test for the whole requested stack.
